article.title: Marcora上架Google Chat，把品牌參考庫帶進行銷與銷售對話
article.title_en: Marcora brings brand-reference answers and drafts into Google Chat
article.summary: Marcora宣布Google Chat行銷代理上架，團隊可在工作對話中查詢品牌定位與競爭資料，並草擬內容。
article.summary_en: Marcora announced its Google Chat marketing agent for brand-positioning and competitor questions and content drafts within work conversations.
highlights: 代理使用團隊整理的品牌基礎及參考庫，可組合不同角色與行業的訊息。
每人須連接帳戶；Google Workspace可能需管理員允許，Teams群組聊天不支援。
highlights_en: The agent draws on curated brand and reference material, combining persona and industry context.
Each person connects an account; Workspace approval may be needed, and Teams group chats are unsupported.
article.why: 已批准品牌背景進入工作對話後，產品行銷可決定哪些角色與行業說法可組合成銷售話術，並核對生成稿是否沿用正確依據。
article.why_en: Bringing approved context into chat lets product marketers decide how persona and industry messages combine in sales drafts and inspect their basis.
article.next_step: 選一個買家角色及行業，要求代理組合話術，逐句對照定位、產品與競爭參考，再把已確認版本存回團隊文件。
article.next_step_en: Choose a persona and industry, generate a talk track, compare it with positioning, product and competitor references, then save the reviewed version.
article.detail: 消息來自Marcora公司公告。Google Chat是這次上架重點，Slack、Teams及Buzz亦列為可用介面，各自支援的對話範圍不同。代理可把草稿保存成Marcora文件，讓參考背景與成稿分開管理。編輯建議核對每項說法的適用客群與來源，不把「採用已批准資料」理解為「AI生成稿已獲批准」；本篇亦沒有驗證公司對資料處理的保證。
article.detail_en: Google Chat is the new listing; the issuer also describes Slack, Teams and Buzz with different conversation scopes. Drafts can be saved as Marcora documents. Keep approved reference material separate from approved finished copy, checking audience fit and source support. This report does not independently certify the company's data-handling claims.
